label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: [s01]
Cc: none
Subject: none

Good evening Marek, good evening all,

I would like to respond to the lineup. I do not agree with the decision on Liliana Bąk, and I ask that it be reviewed before the Friday deadline.

First, the procedure. On 1 October you wrote that the coaches of the players would be consulted before the final lineup. I was not asked about Liliana, and the lineup was posted as final. I believe the consultation should take place before the names go to the organisers.

Second, the criteria. The same message said selection would rest on two things: the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier on 24 October. The current lineup follows the rating list alone. In the qualifier Liliana finished second with 5.5/7. She beat Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper. Igor scored 4/7.

Third, the rating itself. Her -81 comes from a single tournament, the Katowice open in early October. She was not in good health already then, for health reasons, and still played all her games. Afterwards she missed about two weeks of training. She is now back at her normal level, and her last three lessons were very good. I do not think the November list shows her real strength.

I want to be clear that I have nothing against Igor. He is a good boy and, as Rafael says, he has had a steady autumn. My point is only that the criteria announced in October should be applied as written.

My proposal is that Liliana plays on board 2. If you prefer to keep the rating in view, I am also fine with a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, with the winner taking board 2. I am happy to agree on a date with Rafael.

Could you let us know by Thursday evening, so there is still time to organise it before you submit the names on 13 November?

Thank you, and best regards,
Oksana
